releaseNotes: Preserves the V15 Firebase login/account flow, dialogue player, Learning/Practice modes, Dialogue Learning Hub and existing learner progress.
Adds a unified Owner Content Library Studio with Dialogues, Vocabulary, Phrases and Publish areas.
Adds searchable vocabulary editing across Core Vocabulary, General Vocabs and dialogue-specific vocabulary.
Adds searchable phrase editing with dialogue allocation support.
Supports adding new vocabulary/phrases, correcting meanings, alternate Hindi meanings, English/Hindi examples, notes and topic metadata.
Uses stable IDs and allocation records so edits do not reset learner progress; content can be allocated to Core, General and one or multiple dialogues.
Adds duplicate/sense warnings, draft/reviewed/published states, archive/restore and revert-local-change controls.
Adds V16 owner-content backup export/import and includes V15 dialogue overrides in the same backup.
Adds optional owner-only GitHub publishing of content/owner-content-v16.json using a session-only fine-grained GitHub token; the token is never stored or exported.
Adds independent Show/Hide Example and Speak Example controls in vocabulary/phrase recall and player settings.
